en.title: Swap Parity
en.description:
You are given a digit string. You may swap two adjacent digits of the same parity (both odd or both even) any number of times. Find the largest number obtainable. Only adjacent digits can be swapped, so an odd digit can never move past an even digit, and vice versa.

The input/output protocol was compiled by this site and does not represent standard input/output given by the original problem.
en.input: One line containing a string num consisting only of the digits 0–9, with 1≤length≤100000.
en.output: Output the largest obtainable number as a string.
en.explanation: See the accompanying solution for the approach, proof of correctness, and complexity.
hints: First identify which objects can be swapped or modified, then observe how local operations affect the overall result.
